result.summary: The page is largely polished, but two edge-clipping issues make horizontally scrollable content look visually cut off.

issues.description: A small, empty-looking portion of the next category pill is visible at the far right of the category row.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or the initial scroll position so the next pill shows enough text to indicate horizontal scrolling, or hide the partial pill cleanly.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is clipped at the right viewport edge, including its restaurant name and delivery information.
issues.suggestion: Use carousel sizing and right padding that reveal a deliberate portion of the next card without cutting text, or keep card labels within the visible card area.
